0022600163.text: The 6-1 Philadelphia 76ers, who are 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East on a three-game winning streak, host the 1-5 Chicago Bulls in their eighth game of the season. Chicago, on a four-game losing streak, is 13th in the East and 4th in the Central, 4 games back. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the 76ers lost 1-2 to the Bulls in 2025-26 and won their most recent meeting 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
